//: The ts-hexagonal pack (ADR LEG-2026-063): the hexagonal monorepo layout of TN-26-012 — bounded contexts under contexts/, apps under apps/, each context split into domain, application and adapters. This file is the DATA half of the pack: what a host reads without executing pack code. sourceRoots are where roles author code (ADR LEG-2026-056). testFileSuffixes repeat the ts family's suffixes so the layout is complete on its own; identical entries merge (ADR LEG-2026-057). generatedFileGlobs are the files only this pack's emitters write, write-denied to every role and drift-checked (ADR LEG-2026-058, TN-26-012 §7). adapterTechnologies are the two out technologies every hexagonal context can use without another pack: in-memory storage and the console stand-in (ADR LEG-2026-061). workspaceTemplates.context is the manifest every context workspace starts from; the generator adds name, private, exports and the adapter pins. projectShippedFiles copy the architecture rulebook and the architecture test into a new project; both are generated files from then on.
//projectIgnoreRules: What setup and builds produce inside each workspace: Bun's isolated installs link every context and app its own node_modules, and an app's build writes dist/. The ts pack ignores the root ones; this pack owns the workspace layout, so it ignores the per-workspace ones (the core accepts only root-anchored rules with a literal first segment).

adapterTechnologies.description: Stores that keep data in a shared InMemoryDatabase object: for tests, local runs and apps with no database yet.
Local stand-ins that print to the console instead of reaching an outside system, named by @implementedBy console.

context.description: One bounded context: a package with domain, application and adapters under src/, exported per layer and per adapter technology.

//tnExampleContracts: The contract paths bounded init shows in the example front matter of docs/tn/README.md: one domain concept and one feature, in this layout (TN-26-012 section 1).
